summary:
Image identity and selected layer hashes do not bound container-store initialization side effects. Trace the exact shipped library and flags through metadata, locks, probes, temp/output backing and cleanup before execution. Root priority remains runner, bake, registration and first BAR consumer. Source-only checks and metadata lookup do not complete that promise.

The signed-package acquisition refusal was an armored-keyring format mismatch. Separately reviewed preparation used the same frozen package/trusted keys and staged signed files without package installation or host-trust change. Preserve the refusal. Acquisition alone does not establish executor ABI, resolved dependencies, helpers, runtime or retirement closure. Old versions and failed originals remain explicit history.

Pinned Skopeo1.21 supports a fresh OVERLAY primary/runroot with additionalimagestores through the RO branch; writable storage.imagestore is different. Private VFS initialization does not qualify fresh overlay. Set private storage configuration before library initialization, bind full image ID/private policy identity, and keep HOME/XDG/cache/auth/temp/output private. Private staging does not repair hardcoded temporary paths or fallback behavior.

The additional RO branch avoids old container/runtime/userns initialization, stale recovery and incomplete-layer cleanup. It still opens existing images.lock/layers.lock as O_RDONLY|O_CREAT and takes shared blocking locks. Existing inode/type/owner bounds and a physically RO view prevent creation from becoming old-store mutation; counter bytes/times remain mutable. Claim neither zero locks, atomicity nor no interference. Layer reconstruction/spooling holds read locks through stream close; actual external deadlines, owned retirement and hard backing remain necessary.

The actual full-copy RO read set includes oldG/overlay-images/images.json, oldG/overlay-layers/layers.json and oldG/overlay-layers/volatile-layers.json: volatile is under old graph, not runtime. Bind presence/identity/hash or explicit absence and validate combined populations without duplicate/incomplete-row repair. A broad legacy inventory cannot cover a missing determining path or block unrelated holds. Bind selected BigData manifest/config association and exact bytes, beyond arbitrary bounded maps or a matching config digest.

An owned private namespace must preserve oldG visible topology through namespace retirement. Private propagation and nonrecursive same-path RO binding avoid redirecting absolute paths into a writable view; relevant descendant mounts need proof. Positive payload/BigData reads require a directory-only ancestor chain and no-follow identity correspondence to that physical view. Lexical prefix, regular final leaf and final O_NOFOLLOW do not stop intermediate symlink escape. Preserve legitimate leaf metadata and separately validate intentional overlay/l links. The aea7 structural gap at https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4516#issuecomment-6404697111 was source evidence, not an observed malicious image or export failure.

Hard bounds include all simultaneous backing, spools, staging and retained archives plus deleted-open files; directory sampling cannot enforce them. Private primary/runroot tmpfs means old ext4/overlay/metacopy flags and VFS results do not qualify its probes. Init still performs support, d_type/mknod, trial-mount and metacopy probes; skip_mount_home does not remove them. Preserve signed binary/ELF pins, mappings/caps, helper absence, composefs restrictions and actual original cleanup. Physical RO in one view does not freeze other writers. OFD read leases block cooperating writers only; selected Root-team disposition must cover noncooperating mutation for the exact source/operation/readset through streams and namespace retirement.

Pinned inspect --raw returns GetManifest(nil) before config/GetBlob or lazy RO-layer consumption. Full-ID lookup in a namespace-private physically RO additional image store needs genuine overlay-images/images.json, the selected full-ID/default manifest and a newly precreated PRIVATE images.lock. No layer/volatile index, layers.lock or payload is needed; invented empty substitutes establish nothing. A new coordination lock is distinct from replacing a live old lock. Bind original retained bytes, provenance, sizes/digests and any explicit singleton derivation. Freeze a closed regular-file/no-follow inventory with no live oldG aliases. Dedicated metadata mode must refuse copy and avoid live-store full-copy preflight.

Root accepted the actual smaller projection prefix at https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4516#issuecomment-6407605875. Genuine338652-byte index and1633-byte default manifest plus new64-byte private lock were observed in a physical RO projection. One pinned signed1.21 inspect --raw returned actual0 and the exact manifest digest. Actual private64MiB/tmp,1GiB/8192-inode aggregate bulk and matching owned namespaces were captured. Probe paths were absent before execution; native-overlay success, metacopy-false and mount-program-false were captured afterward without inherited old cache. Those facts qualify this initializer/lookup branch, not all overlay features or another backing/profile.

The actual worker/guard results and two original collections joined signed-child retirement. Root checked ten native/relay/caller writers, common/relay absence, separate Root prepare/retire and outer caller/observer/actual carrier cold, and128MiB/16384-inode physical-journal retirement inside original900 with separate inner600. Every219 archive member, including216 regular-file bytes, matched retained custody. Archive bytes alone prove no writer or mount settlement; distinct actual receipts supplied it. No image-config/layer/payload transfer, export, bake, VM, registration or consumer was qualified. Deliberate exhaustion/deleted-open workloads were not added to this lookup run; full export still owes its physical bound and acceptance. Earlier473d failure and missing post-mount facts remain FAILED/Unknown despite separately successful owned-journal recovery.

The next full-copy blocker is a real ordering cycle, documented at https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4516#issuecomment-6407608352: the outer requires actual original-worker cgroup directory/kill handles before launching the wrapper that creates the worker. The producer is absent in the qualified lookup source. Home owns the split: create a supervised worker behind a read gate, establish surviving outside-observer custody of actual birth/unit/source/clock-bound containment handles and preservation lease, then release one reader only after exact gates pass. Missing, late or uncertain custody refuses before selected old-store reads. An opened kill handle alone cannot settle every exceptional namespace/stream holder. Current read-set provenance, Root-team writer disposition, topology, dependency/helper, simultaneous-backing and retirement closure remain required.

The earlier loader/runtime MODULES mismatch showed that freezing one loader does not establish every execution projection. Verify the complete actual source closure and preserve the original gap. Metadata success does not waive live-reader fencing or authorize payload work; actual native qualification, whole cleanup, source publication and first-consumer adoption remain separate. This record supplies knowledge and cited scope, never an invocation, helper installation, new budget, historical release or later image acceptance.
